final: WITH gender_counts AS (SELECT c.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS invoiced_orders FROM Customers AS c JOIN Orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN Invoices AS i ON i.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY c.gender), per_gender_average AS (SELECT AVG(invoiced_orders) AS avg_invoiced_orders FROM gender_counts) SELECT AVG(g.invoiced_orders) AS avg_above_average_figure, AVG(g.invoiced_orders - a.avg_invoiced_orders) AS avg_amount_above_average FROM gender_counts AS g CROSS JOIN per_gender_average AS a WHERE g.invoiced_orders > a.avg_invoiced_orders
